free_tier.stated: No free tier. Cheapest orderable monthly offer: Server XS, 1 vCPU at 3.1 GHz, 4 GB RAM, 100 GB NVMe on Ceph, 1 IPv4 and an IPv6 /64, 2 Gbit/s uplink, fair-use traffic with 10 TB included, EUR 5.00 per month, cancellable at any time, AMD 7003 (Milan) generation, in the maincubes data centre in Frankfurt am Main; prices include 19% VAT. unverified: the server price table of the hourly ph24 Cloud product is script-rendered, so its prices are unread.
free_tier.notes: The record's tier, VPS S, is a sale-page plan with a larger shape than Server XS: 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB NVMe at EUR 6.40 per month; VPS M is 6 vCPU, 12 GB RAM, 200 GB NVMe at EUR 9.60 per month; VPS L is 8 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 300 GB NVMe at EUR 12.80 per month; the FLASH S plan with the same shape as VPS S at EUR 4.95 per month is marked sold out; a separate hourly ph24 Cloud product at ph24.io/cloud bills a public IPv4 per hour and its server price table did not render

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not stored bytes; the vendor states three daily backups are active by default
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process and its disk

egress.terms: fair-use traffic with 10 TB a month included; the port is 2 Gbit/s on a 50 Gbit/s uplink; hypervisors are connected 2 x 25 Gbit/s (LACP, shared); no overage price was read

interface_detail: an in-house control panel with noVNC console, rDNS management, ISO mounting and automatic password reset; ph24 Cloud has its own client area; no API or CLI was read
tooling: in-house panel; the vendor states Proxmox virtualization with ISO boot and 146 or more ISO images; no API, CLI or Terraform provider was read
chaining: 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM and 100 GB of NVMe at EUR 6.40 a month with 10 TB of fair-use traffic and monthly cancellation, in the maincubes FRA01 data centre, is a larger shape per euro than the entry plans of most budget hosts.

limits.value: 10 TB a month of fair-use traffic included

limits_note: SMTP is closed by default and opened only on request; continuous 24/7 100% CPU use is not permitted on the shared vCPUs.
binding_note: 10 TB a month of fair-use traffic binds before the 2 Gbit/s port speed does, and sustained full CPU use is capped by the fair-use rule on the shared vCPUs.
